newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends lower on bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends lower on bearish sentiment.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended weaker after trading cautiously in late trading ahead of tonight's USDA crop report. SGS's June exports had no impact on the market which fell earlier on technical selling and weaker cash sentiment. If Sept breaks 1,156, then next support is 1,140.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also trended lower on lack of buyers with players also waiting for Caleb Brett's June export.
"Caleb's figure should be around 620,000 and 640,000 tonnes," the trader said.
"Technically, the market looks weak and prices are likely to fall further as the charts show a "sell-signal," a trader said.
"If it (Sept futures) breaks the 1,156 ringgit, then the next suport level will be 1,140," a trader said.
At the close, the September futures contract closed 18 ringgit lower at 1,157 ringgit ($458.40) a tonne.
Activity was also confined to spread dealing. "People were seen liquidating the nearbys and buying forwards," a trader said.
Turnover on the futures market was 2,409 lots.
Physicals saw July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,195 ringgit against bids at 1,190 after trading from 1,195 to 1,187.50.
July (central) saw offers at 1,187.50 versus 1,185 with earlier trades at 1,225 and 1,212.50.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,195 against bids of 1,185, with trades at 1,192.50 and 1,185. Aug (central) was offered at 1,187.50 against bids of 1,182.50 after trading at 1,185 to 1,180.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $505 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug/Sept at $502.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $500.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $545, Aug at $540, Sept at $537.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $537.50. Aug was traded at $540.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $390, Aug at $387.50 and Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290. -- Tan Lee Lee -603- 275-6834 ($1-2.5240)
